# sapintegrationsuite_api_product (Data Source)

Reads a Classic API Management API product (APIProducts) by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_api_product" "sample" {
  name = "SampleProduct"
}

output "sample_product_proxies" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_api_product.sample.api_proxy_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The API product's name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `api_proxy_names` (List of String) Names of the API proxies bundled in this product.
- `description` (String)
- `is_published` (Boolean)
- `is_restricted` (Boolean)
- `scope` (String)
- `status_code` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `version` (String)
